channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — android-security-awesome
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: MobShield — via android-security-awesome
item.description: Modular, open-source RASP library for Android with weighted, tunable threat scoring for root, hooking frameworks (Frida, Xposed), debuggers, emulators and app tampering. Detect-only by default; no telemetry.

item.title: FlutterGuard — via android-security-awesome
item.description: Offline on-device scanner for released Flutter APKs: manifest policy, libraries, endpoints, exposed strings and dependency clues, with local reports.

item.title: WPAForge — via android-security-awesome
item.description: Wi-Fi audit tool for rooted Android that builds candidates from the target SSID and hints and verifies each one against a real association; includes WPS PIN and split-halving attacks, LAN recon and offline .cap/.hc22000 checks.

item.title: Lab-RATS-v1.6 — via android-security-awesome
item.description: A lightweight Java-based Android Remote Administration Tool featuring a modern web interface for remote device interaction and administrative testing.

item.title: SecureCheck — via android-security-awesome
item.description: Open-source app that runs root, Frida, Xposed, tampering, Play Integrity, SSL pinning and other runtime checks, handy for testing bypass techniques against a known target

item.title: Damn Vulnerable Mobile App (DVMA) — via android-security-awesome
